Everything you need to learn AI, in one video This one runs longer than my usual videos because it's the one that matters most. By the end you'll know what every piece is — and exactly how to start today, from zero, with no coding background. PART 1 — LEARN AI. The model is a brilliant mind that has read almost everything and knows nothing about you. The whole world is stuck at chat level. Learning AI for real starts when you give that mind YOUR world: plain files about what you sell, who your customers are, how you talk. That's context. Same model everyone uses — yours knows your customers by name. PART 2 — AUTOMATIONS. Work that fires on its own when something happens. Invoice lands → logged → answered, nobody touched anything. Built on a visual canvas with your real tools, and AI sits inside the flow as the thinking step. Business owners I teach run dozens of these — some save hundreds of hours. And once you can do that, you can describe a tool you wish existed and build it: your ideas turn into products. PART 3 — AI EMPLOYEES. An agent is AI with hands and a goal: plan, do, check, fix, again — until the job is done. An AI employee is an agent that STAYS: memory so corrections stick, skills written once and followed every time, working inside your real accounts, behind guardrails — keys only to its own work, and the risky moves wait for your yes. I run my whole business this way. They work while I sleep; mornings, the finished work is waiting. THREE DOORS for the skills: your own work (hand off the repeating hours), your ideas (products people use), or clients (companies pay real money for people who can wire AI into an operation). None of this needs code. First time in history you build all of it in plain English. The ramp: TODAY write your context files → THIS WEEK first automation → THIS MONTH first agent → THEN your first employee. Each step makes the next one easy. A mind alone is potential. Wired into your business, it's a workforce. #aiautomation #aiagent #aiemployee
